title: Drown in Tears
subtitle: The stone falls in, seeking an answer in the water's depths.

items.text: Courtyard of the Sharma Old House

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Ah, ouch. Is your medic skill really okay?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Hah? Are you questioning my skill? I was always, for most of the time, the best student in first aid class! There, the pain is gone, yeah?

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Well, hmm, not bad.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Hey, I'm not done with your stealing!
Matilda pats her on the wound to show her discontent.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Hey, hey, hey. Ah! I already apologize!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Humph, slick!
Matilda turns her eyes toward the two people standing under the tree.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Hmm. I didn't expect to see this.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: What a spacious yard for a house located right next to the train station!
A massive sacred fig stands in the middle of the yard.
It looks a lot older than it was in the photo, and it has become leafless, like a skeleton.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Old buddy, I'm surprised that you're still here.
His rough hands land on the equally rough bark. The tree responds with nearly imperceptible cracks.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: We have settled everyone so far. I didn't expect so many Manus members here.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: I've never encountered them before. They can't be communicated with. How horrible!
She's still haunted by the battle.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: And, since we meet them here, it means ...

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Kumar did cooperate with the Manus.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Shoot! It's completely out of control.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: The incantation in the cave—She must be able to detect the fluctuation caused by it, and that gave us away.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: But what in the world is her purpose?

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Did she think I would stop her? So she deployed these things to slaughter the village?

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Does revenge matter that much to her?
Kaalaa Baunaa feels everything is so absurd.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: I trusted her. I never believed she would do such a thing, even if we're no longer on the same path.
Vishnu's idol feels particularly hard in Kaalaa Baunaa's soft palm.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: But the reality tells me, my trust in her is nothing but a joke.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Hatred changes people.
Shamane shakes his head.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: It's not a choice, Kaalaa Baunaa. You don't have to feel bad for trusting people. You trust someone because they are trustworthy, but you never need a reason to hate.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Let your guard down for even one second, the toxic idea will sneak into your mind, and it would be impossible to get rid of it.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: It will burn your mind and sanity, until you become an animal living for revenge, even forget your own name.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Oh, don't look at me like that. It's nothing personal! In my mind, she is still my cool and scholarly sister. I was young and easily fooled back then.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: What I said was based on my real-life experience. I was way more outrageous than her!

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Ah, I mean, we were all young once, right?
Kaalaa Baunaa shakes her head and sighs.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: No matter what, she is already on the move. But we don't even know where she is.
While Kaalaa Baunaa and Shamane are talking quietly, in the other corner of the yard, a heated quarrel is taking place between the girls.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Don't even think about it! The painkiller won't last long. There's no way you can drive with a wounded foot!
As soon as Kanjira stands up, Matilda pushes her back to the seat.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: But Sherjah is still out there! She can't use any arcane skills. If she's find by the mask monster ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Even, even if you are right on this, I can't just let you ... Hmm?

items.speaker: SPF-I
items.text: SPF-Ⅰ Portable Contact Device activated. Abnormal arcane skill fluctuation detected. Conducting analysis.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: It just activates itself, eh?

items.speaker: SPF-I
items.text: Source of abnormal arcane skill fluctuation confirmed. Similar faction: Manus Vindictae. Margin of error: 0.121%. Emergency support application sent.

items.speaker: SPF-I
items.text: Adjusted support application priority to: HIGH.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Does it mean we can ask the Foundation for backup now?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: This is great! People, I finally got in touch with the Foundation!

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Yeah? That's good news!

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: But the Manus is still wandering out there.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Before the Foundation evacuates them, the village will be destroyed.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: We can't just sit around and watch.
Kaalaa Baunaa looks down at the glasses. Her finger gently swipes across the broken temple.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: There is another way.
She speaks up, though hesitantly, after the long silence.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Way? What way?

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: If she can do it, I can do it, too.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Maybe I can find traces of her if I enter the Realm.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Because I also mastered meditation skills.
Kaalaa Baunaa's eyes fix on a stone. She's lost in her thoughts.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Yes, that's right. I know the path inside.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: What do I need? Yes, water, enough water to soak me in.
Her eyes can't help but move to the large ceramic vat in the corner.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Ms. Kaalaa Baunaa?

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Now, hold on. Please wait.
Shamane waves his hand in front of the researcher, who is already carried away by some emotion.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: If it was so easy, why don't you look for her in the Realm in the first place?

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: It is a risky move. Am I right?

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: How did you know?

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Oh, just my instincts, or experiences, perhaps.
He gives her a gentle wave of his hand.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: No offense, but when I look at you, I see a desperate tiger cub cornered by the hunters.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: The situation is not as simple as you think.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Since she can "invite" us to Mor Pankh, she can play the same trick and "invite" you to her Realm.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: This could be a trap, a trap to keep you stuck inside the Realm.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: You are right. It is a risky move.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: With the other two idols as her anchors, she is the true dominator of the Realm now.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: I can't foresee what's ahead of us in there, so I've been avoiding it.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: But ...
Kaalaa Baunaa looks up at him.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: We don't have other choices, do we?

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Whoa. Now we are talking, you seem ready.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: But, hmm ...
He shakes his head with slight disapproval.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Whatever you decide to do next, don't. This is the advice from an experienced hunter.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Why?

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Because whatever is in your mind now is going to send you into the hunter's trap. This happens to all kinds of animals. When the animal realizes it is cornered, its mind will be in a muddle.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: It can't think of anything else, but at the same time, it strangely grows overconfident. It will take the gamble of escaping from its last way out, which is also going to be the entrance of the trap.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Trust me.
He seems unusually serious.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: I know how you feel. You thought there's no way out but a footlog bridge.
She stares at his face for a long time. Eventually, she shakes her head.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: The Manus followers are still wandering about, and some villagers haven't been moved to safer locations.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: But sometimes, we must take the risky path to get out of the dreadful situation, even though it is full of traps.
He notices her fingers clutch and loosen repeatedly out of anxiety.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: It may not solve all the problems, but it's better than doing nothing.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: If this really is a trap, that means we will meet again.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: And I have been waiting for a chance to talk to her face-to-face for too long.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: I have been chasing after an imaginary goal since she left me.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: I watched that star closely, taking down everything that I could observe. However, despite all the efforts, deep down, I know better than anyone else—it's useless.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: I remember those days, almost half of which were like living in a mist. But now ...

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: But now, I can feel it. Her silhouette is right there in front of me.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: To be honest, this is not the best time to "seize this chance."

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Ms. Kaalaa Baunaa.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: But no matter how I look at it, this is too good an opportunity to pass up.
Shamane meets her gaze squarely.
Then he blinks. He scratches his head, feeling a bit powerless.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Emm. Okay. Fine. *sighs*

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: If you insist on doing this, I will not stop you.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: We all have our lessons to learn. And you are right—we don't have any better options.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: What is it they say? No risk, no feast, huh?

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: But please keep this in mind—no matter what happens, your safety will always be the top priority.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: We cannot bear to lose someone who is capable of putting this to an end.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: I will.
